title: gentianella crinita subsp. victorinii
intro: Gentianella crinita subsp. victorinii, commonly known as Victor's gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella crinita subsp. victorinii include stimulating digestion, increasing appetite, and acting as an expectorant to ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and gentiavine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
